title: UV Exposure Log UV Index Leaderboard
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uv:exposure uv_index=*
| stats sum(uv_index) as total_value, avg(uv_index) as avg_value by location
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks location values by total and average uv index across UV exposure log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `uv_index` values for each UV exposure log event and review total and average uv index by location.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total uv index.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which location shows the biggest uv index numbers in your UV exposure log data.
